children: Calgary, Alberta--(Newsfile Corp. - November 27, 2026) - International Frontier Resources Corporation

(OTCQB: IFRTF) ("IFR" or the "Company") reported today its financial and operating results for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026. Selected financial and operational information is set out below and should be read in conjunction with IFR's September 30, 2026 interim financial statements and the related management's discussion and analysis ("MD&A"). The financial statements and MD&A are available for review on the SEDAR+ website at
and on the Company's website at
. All dollar figures are in Canadian dollars unless otherwise indicated.

The Company reported consolidated net income of $596,060 ($0.02 per share) for the three months ended September 30, 2026, compared to a net loss of $313,945 ($0.01 per share) for the same period in 2025. For the nine months ended September 30, 2026, the Company reported a net loss of $176,050 ($0.00 per share), compared to a net loss of $788,790 ($0.02 per share) in the prior year. Cash used in operating activities was $266,020 for the nine months ended September 30, 2026.

International Frontier Resources Corporation (IFR) is a Canadian publicly traded company with a demonstrated track record of advancing oil and gas projects. Through its Mexican subsidiary, Petro Frontera S.A.P.I. de C.V. (Frontera) and strategic joint ventures, it is advancing the development of petroleum and natural gas assets in Mexico.
The Company's shares are listed on the TSX Venture Exchange, trading under the symbol IFR. For additional information please visit
